scope: Exact materialized governed OAuth replacement; reuse prior sealed review for unchanged prefix.

findings.conclusion: The case replaces a direct grant save with interactiveAttempt against the same real owned endpoint and file-backed store. It requires initial absence and reload matching issuer, resource, client ID, read scope, issued access/refresh tokens and parseable expiry. Existing authorizeNativeMcpOAuth performs S256/state/iss validation and awaits store.save. The final facts require successful authorization, valid forms and exactly one authorization/token exchange.

installCatalog overrides only the MCP endpoint, preserving its unauthenticated PRM/read challenge; the other interactive routes remain. Authorization request facts are copied before later resolve discovery. The expected five-request authorization transcript and six authenticated methods match resolve, reviewed catalog, mount catalog recheck and call-time tools/list followed by one tools/call. No new helper or transport behavior is introduced.

The real helper returns expires_in=3600; product tokenRequest stores an ISO expiresAt. The exact receipt expiry must therefore equal that reloaded grant rather than the old seed null. Non-null auth, exact keys/issuer/read scope, reviewed catalog digest/protocol and explicit stateless 2026-07-28 checks remain. The actual sample is still emitted only when the receipt secrecy boolean permits it.

New public facts and assertion operands contain only booleans, method/path/status/header-presence and counts. They do not expose grants, access/refresh tokens, authorization URL/query, code or verifier. Existing secret registration, recursive AggregateError sanitization, encoded-record secret refusal, outcome/row/decrypted-payload secrecy and redaction assertions remain intact.

Safe authorization facts are retained before later resolution. The full body catch and independent mount/toolset/session/vault cleanup tail are unchanged, preserving body-first AggregateError ordering. Existing governed assertions precede the new transcript assertions, so earlier failure may mask later checks; only actual execution establishes reach.
New local booleans and storedGrant null narrowing fit existing interfaces; explicit imported NativeMcpOAuthConfig typing is unchanged. This static conclusion is not a compiler result.
